entities.summary: Flaminio del Turco was an Italian architect and sculptor. He was born and active mainly in Siena, Italy. Along with Damiano Schifardini, he helped erect the Collegiata di Provenzano. He also helped the design the church of Santa Lucia, Montepulciano. He completed some altars for the Sienese churches of San Raimondo and San Giovannino della Staffa.
